meta.title: Research Ethics & Compliance
meta.description: 15+ compliance requirements with timelines and implementation steps

requirements.name: IRB Approval
requirements.description: Institutional Review Board review and approval for human subjects research
requirements.whenNeeded: Any research involving human participants (interviews; surveys; observations; biosamples)
requirements.documentation: IRB approval letter; protocol summary; consent form
requirements.penalties: Research suspension; disqualification; legal liability; publication rejection

requirements.name: Informed Consent
requirements.description: Ensure participants understand study and voluntarily agree
requirements.documentation: Signed/documented consent; IRB approval; consent form copies
requirements.penalties: Research suspension; publication rejection; legal liability

requirements.name: Confidentiality
requirements.description: Protect participant privacy and sensitive information
requirements.whenNeeded: All human subjects research with identifiable data
requirements.documentation: De-identification log; access log; code key (secured separately)
requirements.penalties: Legal liability; publication rejection; loss of trust; potential criminal charges

requirements.name: Vulnerable Populations
requirements.description: Additional protections for vulnerable groups (children; prisoners; pregnant women; fetuses; cognitively impaired)
requirements.whenNeeded: Research involving legally vulnerable or cognitively vulnerable populations
requirements.documentation: IRB protocol with enhanced safeguards; documentation of vulnerability assessment
requirements.penalties: Research suspension; additional penalties for vulnerable population harm

requirements.name: Data Protection & Security
requirements.description: Safeguard sensitive and personal information from unauthorized access
requirements.whenNeeded: Research with sensitive data (health; financial; demographic; biometric)
requirements.documentation: Encryption certificates; access logs; data handling plan; security audit results
requirements.penalties: Data breach liability; fines under GDPR/HIPAA; publication rejection; legal liability

requirements.name: HIPAA Compliance
requirements.description: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act compliance for protected health information (PHI)
requirements.whenNeeded: Research with U.S. health data or health information
actions: 2. Develop Business Associate Agreement if needed
requirements.documentation: HIPAA training certificate; BAA; de-identification documentation; compliance audit

requirements.name: GDPR Compliance
requirements.description: General Data Protection Regulation compliance for EU resident data
requirements.whenNeeded: Research with data of EU residents
requirements.documentation: DPIA documentation; consent records; DPA; Data protection policy
requirements.responsibleParty: Data controller (researcher); Institutional legal; Data Protection Officer
requirements.penalties: Fines up to €20 million or 4% global revenue; legal liability; publication rejection

requirements.name: Conflict of Interest
requirements.description: Identify and manage financial/personal interests that could bias research
requirements.whenNeeded: All research with potential financial interests (funding source; employment; equity)
requirements.documentation: COI disclosure form; management plan; recusal documentation
requirements.penalties: Publication rejection; retraction; loss of funding; reputation damage; legal action

requirements.name: Publication Ethics
requirements.description: Ensure ethical publication practices and responsible dissemination
requirements.documentation: Publication manuscript; declarations; data availability statement; funding acknowledgment
requirements.penalties: Publication rejection; retraction; authorship disputes; career damage; legal liability

requirements.name: Authorship
requirements.description: Ensure fair recognition and documentation of contributor contributions
requirements.penalties: Authorship disputes; publication retraction; reputation damage; legal action

requirements.name: Plagiarism Prevention
requirements.description: Avoid reproducing others' work without attribution
requirements.documentation: Plagiarism check report; source documentation; properly cited manuscript
requirements.penalties: Publication rejection; retraction; dismissal; loss of degree; reputation damage; legal liability

requirements.name: Research Integrity
requirements.description: Conduct research honestly without fabrication; falsification; or deception
requirements.documentation: Lab notebook; protocol documentation; preregistration; analysis plan; communication records
requirements.penalties: Retraction; loss of funding; career termination; legal action; institutional sanctions

requirements.name: Animal Care
requirements.description: Ethical use of animals in research (if applicable)
requirements.documentation: IACUC approval letter; protocol; training certificate; vet oversight documentation
requirements.penalties: Research suspension; legal liability; publication rejection; facility inspection findings

requirements.name: Conflict of Interest Disclosure
requirements.description: Disclose funding sources and conflicts of interest
requirements.whenNeeded: All research with external funding or conflicts
requirements.documentation: Funding acknowledgment; publication declarations; grant documentation; funding source records
requirements.penalties: Publication rejection; retraction; reputation damage; funder sanctions

requirements.name: Training
requirements.description: Complete Responsible Conduct of Research training
requirements.whenNeeded: Required for most research; particularly grant-funded
requirements.documentation: RCR training certificate; training completion record
requirements.timeline: Before conducting research; renew per institutional requirements
requirements.penalties: Ineligibility for funding; publication rejection; institutional sanctions
